<?php
// Test post types for Easy Hierarchy
add_action('init', function () {
    register_post_type('doc', [
        'label' => 'Docs',
        'labels' => ['name' => 'Docs', 'singular_name' => 'Doc', 'all_items' => 'All Docs', 'search_items' => 'Search Docs', 'not_found' => 'No docs found.'],
        'public' => true,
        'hierarchical' => true,
        'menu_icon' => 'dashicons-book',
        'supports' => ['title', 'editor', 'page-attributes'],
    ]);
    register_post_type('chapter', [
        'label' => 'Chapters',
        'labels' => ['name' => 'Chapters', 'singular_name' => 'Chapter', 'all_items' => 'Chapters'],
        'public' => false,
        'show_ui' => true,
        'show_in_menu' => 'tools.php',
        'hierarchical' => true,
        'supports' => ['title', 'page-attributes'],
    ]);
});
